# Content provenance compliance checklist

Complete when a PR changes source-document registry entries, license or access
rules, [`NOTICE`](../NOTICE), or derivative/modification wording.

- [ ] CC-BY-4.0 attribution matches `SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ENTRIES` `attributionStatement`
- [ ] Change notice states SRD content was modified, reshaped, and/or abbreviated
- [ ] License link: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode
- [ ] Derivative homebrew attribution obligations are still documented

See [packages/contracts/docs/content-provenance.md](../packages/contracts/docs/content-provenance.md).
